## Source
.design/m5/42-polaris-nsids.md — REQ-2, REQ-3, REQ-7, AC-2, AC-4 + Suggested-decomposition PR 2.

## Surface
- New workspace member: `polaris-lexicons/`
  - `Cargo.toml` — minimal deps: `serde`, `serde_json`, `chrono`, optional `proto-blue-lexicon` for runtime validation. No `tokio`, no `reqwest`. Must build for `wasm32-unknown-unknown`.
  - `src/lib.rs` — module re-exports for the generated tree. Only re-exports; no hand-written logic.
  - `src/generated/` — codegen output (no manual edits ever).
- New xtask binary: `xtask/src/gen_lexicons.rs`
  - Reads `lexicons/polaris/*.json`
  - Invokes `proto-blue-codegen` against each
  - Writes Rust output to `polaris-lexicons/src/generated/`
  - Idempotent: running twice yields a no-op diff.
- New CI step in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`:
  ```yaml
  - name: lexicon codegen is in sync
    run: |
      cargo xtask gen-lexicons
      git diff --exit-code polaris-lexicons/src/generated
  ```
  Diff non-empty → CI fails. This enforces the "no hand-written code in generated/" rule mechanically.

## Workspace integration
- Add `polaris-lexicons` to `[workspace.members]` in root `Cargo.toml`.
- Do NOT add it to `polaris-backend` or `polaris-frontend` dependencies in this PR — that wiring lands when consumers actually need it (federation PR or frontend federation UI).

## Rust-quality notes
- **Codegen output is a leaf crate.** It depends on nothing in the workspace. This is what makes `wasm32-unknown-unknown` builds clean: no transitive `tokio` / `reqwest` leak. Verify with `cargo tree -p polaris-lexicons --no-default-features`.
- **`build.rs` is the wrong place for codegen.** Reason: `build.rs` runs on every `cargo build` and the generated code is committed — running codegen at build time creates a chicken-and-egg with the diff-check CI. `cargo xtask gen-lexicons` is the explicit, opt-in invocation.
- **Workspace deps style.** Use `proto-blue-codegen = { workspace = true }` after promoting to `[workspace.dependencies]`. Versions live in the workspace manifest only; per-crate Cargo.toml uses `.workspace = true`.
- **No `unwrap` / `expect` in xtask gen path.** xtask binaries are user-facing CLIs; failure surfaces via `anyhow::Result<()>` with `.context("…")` at every IO boundary (per rust-quality §3, binary-crate rule).
- **`#![deny(missing_docs)]` on `polaris-lexicons` lib.rs** — the generated tree must produce doc-comments per Lexicon `description` field. Verify with `cargo doc -p polaris-lexicons --no-deps -- -D warnings`.
- The xtask's `gen_lexicons::run()` returns `anyhow::Result<()>`; the `#[derive(Debug)]` on its config struct lets `--help` show defaults.

## External references
- proto-blue codegen entry point: `/home/doll/proto-blue/proto-blue/proto-blue-codegen/src/lib.rs`
- proto-blue-api (reference: a fully codegen-output crate) `/home/doll/proto-blue/proto-blue/proto-blue-api`
- xtask pattern (existing in-repo): `/home/doll/Polaris/xtask/src/main.rs` — extend the `Command` enum, add a new subcommand handler.
- Cargo workspace deps: https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/reference/specifying-dependencies.html#inheriting-a-dependency-from-a-workspace

## Acceptance (AC-2 + AC-4)
- [ ] AC-2: `cargo xtask gen-lexicons` produces zero diff when run against an already-generated tree. CI fails on any diff.
- [ ] AC-4: `cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p polaris-lexicons` succeeds in CI. Add a matrix entry to ci.yml.
- [ ] Bonus: `cargo doc -p polaris-lexicons --no-deps -- -D warnings` clean.
